classes.name: results
classes.reason: probe.write_staged does open+write+fsync so the rank stalls until the data is durable, and since each generation is bracketed by barrier.wait() (release measured as sum of max per-generation times), every rank waits for the slowest rank's fsync before proceeding.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: probe.write_buffered just opens, writes and closes with no fsync and its timing is never recorded, so the write drains in the page cache behind the rank's ongoing task loop and only that rank is ever involved.
